features.title: Smart templates
features.description: Save your own templates that your team can insert or use to generate content.

features.title: Social and PDF export
features.description: Share your Chronicle as a high quality PDF or beautiful animated GIF.

features.title: Themes & branding
features.description: Add your logo, and switch up colors, fonts and backgrounds to match your style.

features.title: Smart canvas
features.description: Drag widgets in a freeform canvas, then tidy up to snap elements into neat layouts.

features.title: Real-time collaboration
features.description: Work together live with shared editing, cursors, and team workspaces.

features.title: Publish to web
features.description: Turn your Chronicle into a shareable link and track engagement and views.

testimonials.quote: I've tried many AI presentation tools, but Chronicle really stands out for me. It's fast and easy to create beautifully designed slides. This feels like the future of presentation creation.
testimonials.author: Ravi Mehta

testimonials.quote: Playing with Chronicle and I'm very impressed. One of my favorite parts of being a designer is finding a product with A+ design details. Chronicle is absurdly good.
testimonials.author: Ridd

testimonials.quote: No one on the planet knows presentations as deeply as these guys. I have no idea how anyone else will compete against them in this market. The product speaks for itself.
testimonials.author: Juan Alzugaray
